card.fact_statement: House elections in the Philippines use a modified party-list proportional representation system.
card.source_span: For House elections, each voter has two votes, one via FPTP, and the other via a modified party-list proportional representation system.

target_qa_variants.expected_answer: representación proporcional por listas de partidos modificada
